_source.notes: Item mode: limit defaults to 10 per item when >1 id (25 for a single id). 'not_found': [ids] is added only when some ids were not returned. text_body >2000 chars is cut and gets 'text_body_truncated': true. Mentions appear only as plain text in text_body (no structured mention field). Board mode returns {message:'Updates retrieved', board_id, url, updates:[...], pagination:{page,limit,count}}, or plain text 'No updates found for board with id <id>' when empty.
_source.synthetic_values: IDs, names, dates are invented; key names, nesting and ordering follow the source.
